clinical_intent: A 75-year-old woman named Dorothy2 has a Stage IIA cervical cancer. She is a Jehovah's Witness and has stated that she will not accept blood transfusions under any circumstances. She needs brachytherapy with interstitial needle placement. Given the bleeding risk associated with interstitial procedures, discuss how to manage this patient safely while respecting her religious beliefs.
